description:
Lighter.NET.DB is a Lightweight ORM data access layer utilizing Entity Framework 6.5.1. It aims to provide an easy to use and flexsible and more efficient db access experience for developer. 

With Lighter.NET.DB, you can seamlessly combine ORM and conventional SQL script coding style for data access operations in a concise and efficient manner. Moreover, you can say goodbye to the long-winded Entity Data Model file structures, such as *.edmx, *.Context.tt, *.Designer.cs, and unecessary DbSet for db table mapping.

It features the followings:
1. Full select, insert, update, delete support using ORM approach, as well as using conventional SQL script approach.
2. Easy data paging for select result set or even for mass insert or update.
3. Automatic logging for update and delete operation.
4. Simpify the transactional db operations that eliminates all the boilerplate code of using tranaction, try...catch, commit when success and rollback when failure.
5. Auto increment column and Sequence support.
6. A full-featured where condition builder which is easy to use and significanly simplify the complexity when multiple optional filter columns are involved. 
7. An improved DbContext dispose mechanism which based on the "Always dispose after usage unless explicitly declaring for reuse" policy.
releaseNotes:
1. Change: **Note: compilation error may occur and code modification should be required**, due to the datatype of the ICreator.createBy and ICreator.createAt is changed from non-nullable type to nullable type to reduce unnecesary model validation error and security risk of sensitive data exposure.
 2. Add: A IdentifierValidator for validating the identifier input argument and as a measure for SQL injection prevention.
 3. Add: New methods of the DbServiceBase for manipulate the SQL Server sequence object including CreateSequence(), GetNextSequenceNumber() and GetSequenceNameList().
 4. Add: The new DbServiceBase<T>.SelectTop() for querying the top N rows of the resulting records.
 5. Add: New DbServiceBase<T>.Select() overload methods which accept a WhereBuilder argument for complex conditional querying.
 6. Enhance: A limitRowCount optional argument is added to a part of the DbServiceBase<T>.Select() methods. When specified, only to top N rows will be returned.
 7. Enhance: The generic type constraint of the DbServiceBase.Select<T>() is removed to better support both primitive and custom class types.
 8. Enhance: When the data model has auto increment property (decorated with [AutoIncrement] attribute), the DbService.Insert() will retrive back the auto increment value and update the value of the model.AutoIncrementProperty after inserted.
 9. Enhance: Safeguard the DbServiceBase<T>.Delete() to prevent mistakenly deleting the entire table records when a null parameter object is given.
 10. Remove: The DbServiceBase<T>.SelectOptionItems() with OrderByType argument is removed due to the OrderByType enum is deprecated and is replaced by OrderMode enum.
